newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Altera, VideoServer up.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Altera, VideoServer up.

text.p: Shares of Altera Corp and VideoServer Inc were up in after hours trade on earnings news, traders said Wednesday.
Altera traded up 2-1/8 to 56 and VideoServer traded up 1-1/2 to 39-1/2 after hours.
Altera reported third quarter earnings of $0.53 a share, compared to $0.52 a share the previous third quarter.
VideoServer reported third quarter earnings of $0.17 vs $0.08.
The New York Stock Exchange said that Stanhome Inc was unavailable for after hours trade.
The NYSE said that session one volume was 7,000 shares, compared to 11,500 shares Tuesday. Session two volume was 2,485,758 shares versus 397,051 shares.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
